violation_type.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Meet federal standards (26 TAC §746.5607(e)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Meet federal standards
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the DFPS investigation there is sufficient evidence to suggest that an 11-month-old infant was transported in a booster seat instead of a rear facing car seat as required.
